name: pane-undo
title: Undo and Redo from the right pane's Overview
about: The same run as review-undo, undone and redone with the buttons in Overview (Undo last run, Redo), with the same checks on the files, the person's checkout and the follow-up that tells the agent.

steps.expect: The run edits files in its worktree and finishes
The run card offers Review and Undo
Overview offers Undo last run for the run

sh.run: cd "$(git -C files/acme-api worktree list --porcelain | sed -n 's/^worktree //p' | tail -n 1)" && cat README.md

steps.expect: Before Undo the worktree holds the run's edit
Undo is done; the card offers Redo

sh.run: cd "$(git -C files/acme-api worktree list --porcelain | sed -n 's/^worktree //p' | tail -n 1)" && cat README.md
cd "$(git -C files/acme-api worktree list --porcelain | sed -n 's/^worktree //p' | tail -n 1)" && cat OLD.md docs/guide.md
cd "$(git -C files/acme-api worktree list --porcelain | sed -n 's/^worktree //p' | tail -n 1)" && ls src/retry/mod.rs logo.png docs/start.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '

steps.expect: Undo restored every file: the edit, the deletion, the rename, and removed the new files

sh.run: cd "$(git -C files/acme-api worktree list --porcelain | sed -n 's/^worktree //p' | tail -n 1)" && git status --porcelain

steps.expect: The worktree is back to its branch's state (git status is clean)
The person's checkout is untouched: HEAD, branch, index and status
Redo is done; the card offers Undo again

sh.run: cd "$(git -C files/acme-api worktree list --porcelain | sed -n 's/^worktree //p' | tail -n 1)" && cat README.md
cd "$(git -C files/acme-api worktree list --porcelain | sed -n 's/^worktree //p' | tail -n 1)" && cat src/retry/mod.rs
grep -q 'the person undid the changes of your last run' fake-record.jsonl && echo yes

steps.expect: After an undo, the follow-up's words to the agent start with the line that says so
The person's checkout is still untouched
